detail.longDescription: 🔁 FeedEcho v1.33.0 adds import/export. Back up your feeds, accounts, and echoes to a single JSON file, then import it anywhere. Migrate from a self-hosted instance to the hosted service, or back out. Re-importing is a no-op so nothing duplicates. The export carries your account tokens (it's your data), and future hosted plan limits are enforced on import. https:// github.com/jcrabapple/feedecho /releases/tag/v1.33.0 # selfhosted # rss # fediverse
